text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho, one of three races of the much-coveted Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowds at the racecourse are all eager to see the Mejiro family showdown that is to soon take place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen boldly braces herself for the sincere contest she promised to provide Mejiro Ryan. Both will hold nothing back in order to win.
